examples.english: “When then Andrew had said this, the spirit of the Saviour was roused in him; he cried out and said: How long am I to endure you? How long am I to bear with you? Have ye then not even yet understood and are ye ignorant? Know ye then not and do ye not understand that ye and all angels and all archangels and the gods and the lords and all the rulers and all the great invisibles | and all those of the Midst and those of the whole region of the Right and all the great [ones] of the emanations of the Light and their whole glory,”
